Closes exactly. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain test was possible here.

escalation_note: 600 dpi strip crops of the Form A header+rows, Form B rows 1-4 and rows 4-5, the cover totals block, and six single-cell geometry-proof crops. The date glyph was the only bistable read: the leading digit of '4-2'/'4-7' on Form A could be read 4 or 9 at 200 dpi. Settled at 600 dpi AND by the writer's own hand elsewhere in the document (Form B '4-9','4-11','4-11','4-11','430'; the '4's in the cover's '12-3-2014', '8434', '1543') and by semantics (the Form B rows are county-convention expenses: 'Booth at Convention', 'Convention Items'). No amount required an arithmetic reversal: both schedules gate exactly on first reading.
